recipe.name: Grapefruit G&T
recipe.description: A bright, floral zero-proof highball: pink gin-style botanicals, fresh grapefruit and a warm lift of ginger, lengthened with ginger ale.
steps: Press the ginger slices lightly in the bottom of a highball glass to release their oils.
Fill the glass with ice, then add the Sober pink gin and the fresh grapefruit juice.
Top with chilled ginger ale and stir once, gently, to keep the fizz.
recipe.garnish: Grapefruit wedge and a slice of ginger
recipe.serving: Serve straight away, while the ginger ale is lively.
